scripts.build: node scripts/generate-sitemap.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true});for(const f of ['index.html','404.html','admin','assets','images','css','js','robots.txt','sitemap.xml']){if(fs.existsSync(f)){fs.cpSync(f,p.join('dist',f),{recursive:true});}}"
